title: JSON API: assets
interface: Blueprint `bp` (name 'api_assets'; the app mounts it at /api/v1). All routes require api_auth_required. GET /assets?status=&type=&q= -> 200 list. POST /assets JSON -> 201 dict; AssetValidationError -> 400 {'error'}; DuplicateAssetTag -> 409 {'error'}; missing asset_tag/type -> 400. GET /assets/<int:id> -> 200 | 404 {'error': 'not found'}. PATCH /assets/<int:id> JSON -> 200 updated | 400 | 404. POST /assets/<int:id>/retire -> 200 | 400 | 404. POST /assets/<int:id>/lost -> 200 | 400 | 404. Build AssetService(AssetRepository(get_db()), AuditRepository(get_db())) per request; actor from guards.actor().
